class.name: JRPGNumberInputWindow
class.brief_description: The number input window: 1 to 8 digits, changed one at a time.
class.description: Asks for a number as Input Number does. [code]jrpg_up[/code] and [code]jrpg_down[/code] change the digit under the cursor (9 goes round to 0 and back), [code]jrpg_left[/code] and [code]jrpg_right[/code] move between digits (round at the ends), repeating while held; [code]jrpg_ok[/code] enters the number ([signal number_entered]). There is no cancel. The window sits at the right, beside the message window named by [member message_window]. Authority: client. Online, the server checks the number against the digits it asked for.

method.name: get_cursor
method.description: Returns the digit under the cursor, 0 being the leftmost.

method.name: get_digit
method.description: Returns the digit at [param digit], 0 being the leftmost.

method.name: get_digits
method.description: Returns how many digits the number has.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] from [method start] until the number is entered.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts entering a number of [param digits] digits (1 to [constant MAX_DIGITS]), showing [param value] (cut to those digits; below 0 gives 0). Opens the window and gives it the focus.

members.member: The message window the number input goes beside. Empty: the bottom of the screen.

signal.name: number_entered
signal.description: Emitted when the player enters the number [param value].

constants.constant: The most digits a number can have.
The width of each digit's cell, in pixels.
